market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Settlement at/above $140 requires ~40% rise from current $100 in 2 months — extreme scenario. Forex.com and ING flag full Hormuz closure as a tail risk that could push prices above $130-140, but base case forecasts cap at ~$115-120.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether Hormuz situation escalates to full prolonged closure
